PF-L composite. Model validation on selected evaluation dates: GALE-CAST Model-W1 against persistence and
Selected validation example chosen to demonstrate baseline limitations as requested by the thesis panel; not representative of all historical dates.
Each panel uses its own set of dates, chosen so that GALE-CAST Model-W1's error is lower than both baselines.
Wind and MSLP: station-dates on which persistence's error exceeded GALE-CAST Model-W1's for both wind and MSLP (spec/CASE_SELECTION_v4_persistence_override.md; GALE-CAST
Model-W1 < persistence there by construction). Humidity: dates on which persistence and climatology both failed for humidity (training 90th-percentile rule,
spec/CASE_SELECTION_v3_panel_validation.md). Rainfall: all complete dates. On all complete dates persistence is more accurate than GALE-CAST Model-W1 for wind (0.47 vs 0.99
m/s), MSLP (0.85 vs 1.94 hPa) and humidity (PF-F3). GALE-CAST Model-W1 = saved neural-only next-day output (website scorecard cohort, three primary stations, 2021-11-16 to
2024-12-30); persistence = issue-day observation; climatology = station × month mean 2015-2020; truth = raw PAGASA observations. Run persist-v4-20261025T160430Z-d4511b.
